stemMd: What made the prototype awkward to maintain outdoors?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The benches had no replaceable parts at all.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every site required the same arrangement.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Its fasteners were difficult to reach after installation.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The seat modules could not be drawn on paper.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Maintenance workers were forbidden to use tools.

explanationMd: The prototype’s fasteners became hard to access once installed. This explains why workshop ease did not transfer directly to field maintenance. The modular concept itself was not abandoned.

distractorRationale.d: The issue was practical access, not drafting.
distractorRationale.e: They later tested the design with ordinary tools.
distractorRationale.a: They were designed from replaceable modules.
distractorRationale.b: Rearrangement for different sites was a design goal.
